host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MPD server. Can include port (e.g., 'localhost:6600').

port.description: Port number for MPD connection. Only used if host does not specify a port.

password.description: Password for MPD authentication. Leave empty if MPD has no password.

username.description: Username for your Last.fm or Libre.fm account.

password_hash.description: MD5 hash of your scrobbler account password (not plain text). For Last.fm, hash = md5(username + raw_password).

service.description: Scrobbler service to use. Supported values: 'lastfm' or 'librefm'.

mpd_status_path.description: Optional absolute path to MPD's status file (e.g., /var/lib/mpd/status) for faster song info reads. Leave blank to query MPD directly.

min_play_time.description: Minimum play time (in seconds) before a track is eligible for scrobbling. Shorter plays are ignored.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to standard error instead.

skip_shorter_than.description: Tracks shorter than this (in seconds) are always ignored for scrobbling, overriding min_play_time.

fallback_format.description: Format string for missing track metadata. Supports %a (artist), %t (title), %A (album), %n (track number).

online_status.description: Enable sending 'now playing' status updates in real time (requires scrobbler API support).

ignored_artists.description: List of artist names (case-insensitive) to skip scrobbling for.

ignored_paths.description: List of music directory paths (case-sensitive) to skip scrobbling for.

items.description: Path relative to MPD's music directory to ignore (e.g., 'Podcasts/').
